answer.report_md:
**画出来要什么**

一张单面板折线图：三条序列(All / OECD / Non-OECD)画在同一左侧数值轴上，轴刻度为 0、20…200，纯数字、无单位词；数量含义只能从蓝色标题行「Figure 3.1. Total number of market studies conducted, 2015-2024」回推。两条序列用密集圆点线、一条用粗实线，线型本身承担序列身份。X 轴是 8 个滚动三年窗口 2015/2017…2022/2024，标签旋转约 45°。图例位于绘图区下方一行；只有横向网格线；图下两行小字 Note/Source。图上不印任何数值。

**定位一个值难在哪**

以 175 为例：All 线在 2016/2018 到 2021/2023 之间长期在 172–180 的平台上摆动，网格线间距为 20，容差 5% 只有 ±8.75，几乎无法判定 175 属于哪一个刻度槽；而且点线由许多小圆点组成，落在刻度之间的圆点并不对应某个类目。相比之下 120（OECD 在 2020/2022 的尖峰）反而好读。定位一个值需要「序列名 + 三年窗口」两个标签，且窗口写法非常规。

**不确定的**

175 到底属于 2016/2018 还是更靠后的年份；OECD 的 112 我判为 2019/2021，但也可能是 2021/2023 的下行段。点线的真实数据点数无法数清，我按每序列 8 点计。

heading.title: Total number of market studies conducted, 2015-2024

axes.serves: all three lines: All, OECD, Non-OECD

worked_example.why_hard: Dotted line sits on a flat 172-180 plateau; gridlines every 20; no printed values

components.evidence: "Note: A three-year average is used to smooth out volatility..." and "Source: OECD CompStats database."
a row "All   OECD   Non-OECD" with line swatches sits under the x tick labels
faint horizontal rules at 20, 40 ... 200; no vertical rules in the plot
tick text "2015/2017" ... "2022/2024" is turned about 45 degrees
time written as "2015/2017", "2016/2018", three-year windows rather than single years
All and Non-OECD drawn as dotted lines, OECD as a thick solid line; legend swatches match
left axis shows bare 0-200; the word "number of market studies" appears only in the title

new_components.evidence: x ticks are overlapping three-year averages 2015/2017 ... 2022/2024, explained in the note

answer.hardest_step_why: 图上无数值，网格每20；58 的5%容差仅±2.9，175 位于172-180平台，点线难以对准刻度槽。

examples.quote: the left axis reads 0, 20, 40 ... 200 and no number is printed on any of the three lines
examples.why: 点线在20间距网格上读数，58、175 的±5%容差远小于可达精度，需按标记给出精度而非布尔可读。

examples.quote: x tick labels read 2015/2017, 2016/2018 ... 2022/2024, rotated about 45 degrees
examples.why: 当前流水线不生成滚动三年窗口式旋转刻度文本，时间轴格式需成为可控风格维度。

examples.quote: Figure 3.1. Total number of market studies conducted, 2015-2024
examples.why: 编号、标题与年份区间同在一行蓝字，单位词隐含其中，标题需拆成独立字段。

examples.quote: All and Non-OECD are drawn as sequences of round dots; OECD is a thick solid navy line
examples.why: 线型(点线/实线)承担序列身份，需要把线型作为可生成的编码维度并进入键。
